name: NZ Addresses
description: National point dataset of allocated addresses compiled from territorial-authority advice to LINZ.
story: Territorial authorities allocate addresses and notify LINZ, which maintains the central Address Information Management System (AIMS). NZ Addresses provides national point locations and address components from this maintained source.

LINZ published the NZ Addresses layer on the LINZ Data Service in September 2025, supplying a national address reference for emergency services, asset systems, planning and geographic matching. An address point should not be interpreted as a cadastral boundary.
